verdict.rationale: The only generation path in the evidence is artifacts: they can produce SVG images, diagrams and visualizations from a plain-language description. That is vector or code-rendered output, not native image generation, and nothing shows editing an existing or uploaded image. Image upload is supported, but only as input for Claude to analyze. Missing for 10: native raster image generation from prompts, natural-language editing of existing images, and independent or hands-on corroboration of image-creation quality.
